verdict.rationale: Solo 2 can be driven programmatically through its own interfaces. It speaks standard protocols (FIDO2/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP) that standard tooling like `fido2-token` can use, and it has a documented `solo2` CLI with scriptable commands such as `list`, `update` and LED admin settings. There is no dedicated, documented public API: probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt on the docs site. missing for 10: a first-party API/SDK reference documenting programmatic control, evidence the solo2 CLI or protocol interfaces are kept current and machine-friendly, independent corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: also speaks OATH (TOTP/HOTP), PIV, and OpenPGP

solo2 app admin set led 007f7f 00007f # set led to teal (idle) / blue (active)
